---
title: "Banner Document"
subtitle: "With a banner"
author: "Norah Jones"
date: "2026-07-01"
title-block-banner: true
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z). P5 (bd-364ol5lu): the
# banner header renders above #quarto-content (direct child of body),
# header + banner div carry page-columns page-full, title/subtitle
# live inside div.quarto-title.column-body in the banner, the meta
# grid stays below the banner inside the header, and <main> gains
# quarto-banner-title-block.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header.quarto-title-block.default.page-columns.page-full",
            "header#title-block-header > div.quarto-title-banner.page-columns.page-full > div.quarto-title.column-body > h1.title",
            "div.quarto-title-banner div.quarto-title > p.subtitle.lead",
            "header#title-block-header div.quarto-title-meta p.date",
            "main.content.quarto-banner-title-block#quarto-document-content",
          ]
        - ["main header#title-block-header"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            # The banner header is the FIRST thing in the body, above
            # #quarto-content (P5). This used to be a `body >` DOM selector;
            # the live preview mounts into div#root, so nothing it renders can
            # be a direct child of body -- the placement is pinned on the
            # render output instead (bd-xiz1a2go).
            '<body[^>]*>\s*<header id="title-block-header"',
          ]
        - []
---

Body.
